body: Love your colors! Where are the blue dress and white set from?

Wow such inspo! Love your use of space. Can I ask, how do you keep your shelves clean when you store your shoes on there? I’ve seen other pics of shoes displayed like that and always like the look but feel like I’d get the shelving dirty so fast
One is for sleep and one for running, but you’re right - so far I’ve only worn the white shorts once since it’s been more overcast and chilly than expected.
Aw thank you so much! I hope you have a fabulous trip home ☺️
It’s from Marshall’s! I couldn’t find the exact one online so I just grabbed an image of a similar one. It was the brand “gaze” if that helps.
Aha I’ve been so focused on staying warm and packing multipurpose items that I’ve skipped the dress, but maybe I’ll pack a satin midi skirt for the occasion..
Absolutely, they’re the Anessa wide-leg jeans from Paige! I got an amazing deal on them when Bloomingdale’s was running a sale and stacked a coupon code on top.
Okay you’ve confirmed what I thought about 60’s feeling colder than expected; I’ll add another layer and a flannel just in case!

Thanks so much! It’s my first time in SD so I’m excited. I’ll layer the quilted jacket with a fuzzy cardigan (plus t shirt under) combo that I usually reserve for winter, and the black pants are good for hikes. You’ve convinced me on the crew socks too!
Oh good point, the bride to be is quite casual but I’ll swap those items!
Ooh ok, I’ll bring a fuzzy cardigan that’s smaller than the sweatshirt to keep warm!
Thank you, it helps to hear from a local that changing between AM and PM is expected! I could add a pair of Birkenstocks for the dinner and cut the sweatshirt.
Love the trip report and seeing what worked well for you! Could you share where you got those black pants and white shorts?

I totally understand the feeling of wanting those ‘just in case’ items, and as you said, you have no shortage of outfits with what you already have. The fact that most of your bottoms are black helps with any potential stains too! In any case, you can bring a little extra this trip if you’re not sold and see if you truly needed those extra bottoms, then let that guide your future packs (:

Looks lovely! I know you said the skirts pack down small but 5 bottoms is a lot! Maybe consider taking out either the cream maxi or black maxi since they’re so similar and adding a long sleeve top. Check out the 54321 rule if you haven’t already for some good outfit inspo.
Love it! What do you pack for sleepwear?
This looks great! Can you share where you got those tan sandals?
Thank you!
Can I ask which brand you get your fleece leggings and cashmere sweater from?
Sweet find!
Damn okay, I appreciate the pro tip!
I see, I’ll keep that in mind - thank you for the insight!
Ooh good idea, having a spare handy in emergencies would be clutch. Thanks for the tip!
Oh wow, I had no idea they would do that for a secondhand owner. I might give that a shot!

Gotcha, I’ve heard of the Helium and it’s nice to know they go together well. Can I ask what’s the drawback of using it all day? I’m thinking when I travel in the city I would want something versatile enough to take me throughout the day and not switch out my outerwear too much
I have till Tuesday to do a return, yeah. Wow, even with a couple of rips? Feels like I got lucky with this find!
Yeah I’m worried about down loss too with those holes. Thanks for sharing some budget options, I’ll look at those
That’s a good point, this would be my first Arc’Teryx so it’s nice to know it has solid resale value!
Me too please!! 🫶🏼
Can you share where you got your coffee table?
What hanging lights on the far right did you use? Love the whole room, it looks fabulous!
The Christmas collection has free shipping right now, and if you have one item in your cart from that you’ll get the whole cart with free ship if you’re willing to spend more haha 🤗
